$comment: Canonical cross-channel listing facts for novada-mcp. distribution/generate.mjs reads this file (never the reverse) and writes the fields each distribution/channels.json row declares as OWNED into that channel's manifest. The description below is deliberately WITHOUT a hardcoded tool/platform count — the whole point is that no channel manifest needs to be hand-updated every time a platform or tool is added or removed. Counts live in ONE place at runtime: novada_discover and README.md's generated tool table, not in distribution metadata.
$comment_surfaces: brief-N (2026-10-19, D1 — class-not-instance fix for an independent review's HIGH finding): `description` and `description_hosted` are TWO truthful variants of the same facts, not one shared string blindly reused everywhere. `description` is accurate for a row whose installed artifact runs the full local npm package (channels.json row `surface: "local"` or `"both"` — e.g. Smithery's stdio install, or the MCP Registry's one listing that carries both a local `packages[]` entry AND a hosted `remotes[]` entry) — it explicitly scopes the browser-automation claim to the local npm package, so it stays true even for a "both" row where only ONE of its two install paths has that capability. `description_hosted` is for a row whose installed artifact only ever talks to the HOSTED endpoint (`surface: "hosted"` — Gemini CLI, Antigravity, OpenAI Codex's plugin, the Dify plugin) and drops the browser-automation clause entirely, because `hosted-server/vercel/api/mcp.ts`'s `HOSTED_HIDDEN` set excludes `novada_browser`/`novada_browser_flow` from every hosted response. distribution/generate.mjs's `resolveDescriptionForRow` picks between the two by the row's `surface` field; distribution/check.mjs's `surface_claims` check fails if a `surface:"hosted"` row's resolved/generated description text ever mentions a HOSTED_HIDDEN tool's capability phrase (table-driven off HOSTED_HIDDEN itself, not a hardcoded per-row list) — see distribution/channels.json's own `$comment` for the full row-level contract and distribution/README.md for the worked example that motivated this.
name: novada-mcp
